notes: v609 — THE RADAR NOW HAS A PERMANENT FLOOR ROW. Until now the radar only ever offered two ONE-WAY buttons — nudging you UP to $250k or $1m, and only when you were already at the broadest view. There was no equally quick way to go the other direction, back to Any. Under the one-ruler design a broader floor only ever shows MORE, never less, so it deserved to be just as easy to reach. Added a permanent floor row right next to ‘Market Radar’ — Any / $50k / $250k / $1m / $5m, always visible, one tap, reusing the exact same options and instant setter the report card already uses. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
